text:
Ella (marketing PM): Quick check — VantagePeak case story draft is in the Drive. Need legal signoff + customer approval by Tue 17:00 PT to make next Friday's launch. Also coordinating a co-branded webinar on Jun 14 — who can own registration, landing page, and invites?

Tom (producer): I can take registration + landing page. Proposed timeline: hero quote Mon AM, transcript edits Mon PM, design polish Tue morning.

Priya (legal): Paste exact quote text here. Any explicit percentages/multipliers need source docs or we should soften. Confirm we have a signed media release for the VantagePeak logo.

Ella (marketing PM): Two options from the interview below (A = verbatim, B = hero short).

Tom (producer): ```Option A: "Switching to Redwood cut our inference spend by 58% and improved p99 latency by ~45% — we shipped features faster and with fewer rollbacks."```

Priya (legal): Flags: "58%" and "~45%" and "p99" are quantitative/technical. Either attach benchmark methodology or change to qualitative: "substantially reduced inference spend" and "material p99 latency improvements." Also change "shipped features faster" -> "accelerated feature delivery." Confirm logo/media release.

Jas (growth): For inbound routing, tag demo requests with vantage_launch and route them to the vantage_sdr queue. I'll build a short nurture and add partner CTAs. Need UTM scheme for the webinar landing page.

publishing-bot: Created ticket MKT-1407: "VantagePeak case + webinar setup" and assigned to Tom.

Tom (producer): Short hero candidate: "VantagePeak reduced inference costs and sped up rollouts with Redwood."

Priya (legal): Short hero is ok with edits: replace "sped up" -> "accelerated" and "reduced inference costs" -> "reduced inference costs" (keep). Final hero: "VantagePeak reduced inference costs and accelerated rollouts with Redwood." Pending customer quote signoff and logo release.

Ella (marketing PM): @Jas please confirm SDR queue exists and opt-in text for webinar signups. @Tom drop final hero into the Figma file by Tue 10am (link in the Drive). I'll ping the VantagePeak contact for signoff now.

Jas (growth): Confirmed vantage_sdr queue exists. Opt-in snippet: "By registering you agree to be contacted about Redwood products and partners." UTM params: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=vantage_launch

Tom (producer): Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/vantage-hero  will upload hero, social cards, and webinar banner Tue AM.

Priya (legal): Approved wording as edited. :white_check_mark: Still need signed media release from customer before publish.

Ella (marketing PM): Great — if VantagePeak signs off by Tue 17:00 PT we'll publish Fri and send webinar invites on Wed. I'll update here when I hear back. Thanks team.
